name: Meta
look: Stark white with full-bleed product photography at 32px softening, two-tier pill CTAs and saturated banners used sparingly.

hero.title: Presence, without the cables
hero.sub: A standalone headset with pancake optics, inside-out tracking and hand recognition accurate enough that controllers become optional.

features.title: Hardware that gets out of the way
features.sub: The comfort and tracking problems are what kept the previous generation on a shelf.

items.title: Pancake optics
items.body: Half the depth of the previous lens stack, which is most of why it is comfortable for an hour.

items.title: Hand tracking
items.body: Accurate enough that controllers become optional for most experiences.

items.title: Inside-out tracking
items.body: No base stations. Set it down in any room and it maps the space in seconds.

items.title: Standalone
items.body: No PC and no cable. It runs everything on-device.

items.title: Shared spaces
items.body: Two people in the same room see the same virtual objects in the same places.

items.title: Three-hour battery
items.body: In a rear-mounted pack that also balances the weight off your face.

showcases.title: Built by people, not by us
showcases.body: An open store with a published revenue split and a review process that publishes its criteria. The best experiences on the platform were not made here, and the economics are set up to keep it that way.

showcases.title: An SDK you can read
showcases.body: Native and engine SDKs with the tracking APIs documented rather than wrapped. Performance profiling on device, so you can see which frame budget you blew and where.

gallery.title: EXPERIENCES
gallery.sub: A selection from the store this month.

testimonial.quote: I wore it for an hour and took it off because I was finished, not because my face hurt. That has never happened with a headset before.
testimonial.name: Ravi Chandra

pricing.title: SHOP
pricing.sub: Three configurations. Free returns within thirty days.

items.a: No. Everything runs on the headset. It can connect to a PC for higher-fidelity content, but nothing about the standard experience requires one.
515 grams with the battery mounted at the rear to balance the load. Most reviewers report an hour of comfortable use, which is roughly a session.

items.q: Can I sideload my own software?
items.a: Yes. Developer mode is a setting, not an unlock process, and sideloading does not void the warranty.
Thirty days, used or unused, with free return shipping. Headsets are unusually hard to evaluate in a shop, so the window is deliberately generous.

cta.title: Try it for thirty days
cta.sub: Free returns, used or unused, because you cannot judge this in a shop.

notes: A stark white canvas carries full-bleed product photography with generous 32px corner softening on showcase tiles.
Two tiers of primary button: ink pills for marketing CTAs, cobalt pills for commerce actions inside buy-now panels.
Pills and heavily-rounded cards are the dominant geometric signature throughout.
One variable face covers display and body with consistent stylistic-set features enabled.
Saturated promotional banners above the nav are reserved for time-bound offers and are not part of the standing chrome.
